t: # Short Obligatory Prayer ## To be recited once in twenty-four hours, at noon. Ña'ch mat pay pach ñawe wich oyach, O' Malquayak, mapuch nap ñem sa'ch ñemuyach muyach mesquap. Ñem meech ñach mechkeeñap mapill nap ñawe yew kich p'warr pin map nap ñawey, yew quax'chelpin napuch mu yax. Malquayak pa'as yow low-waym-lax ushet nemam ñem ma'k, ñaway kam lay Malquayak pich ushet nemam supeck eñamcha.
